snippet.title: ⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀ - sage 2025 demo trailer
snippet.description:
Play the short yet impactful demo here:
https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/collision-system-test.2771/
https://phiiraco.itch.io/collision-system-test

⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀  is a surreal RPG-ish Yume Nikki clone where words are a scarce resource.
Exploration is bizarre and unclear, optical illusions are plenty, and every, every little letter you find may be the key to not lose progress in the weird and badly designed world of ⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀ .
See you after you've passed the tree 10 seconds in. You'll never be the same after those leaves.

For SAGE 2025, I've prepared a little demo (it was actually coincidental I started working on this 2 months ago) containing the prologue of this quirky RPG (I SAID THE THING). I can't emphasize the tree enough, it really is one of those things you can only experience once.

Follow me on bluesky for more constant updates:
https://bsky.app/profile/philraco.lhlgames.com

The game is in active development, and while I plan on making a devlog where I talk about how I got here and about adding more depth and a very unique dialogue and traversal system... you shouldn't buy a promise though, which is why I'm okay if you don't give two flicks about my silly anti-design game. You be you!
